notes_en: Live AI Recitation now shows mic capture status live. If the OS blocks the microphone you get an instant 'No microphone audio' warning on screen (with mic chunks: N) instead of a silent 0/29. mic chunks: 0 means the OS is blocking capture (check Settings > Apps > Qari > Microphone = Allow, close other mic apps, restart). Update and allow mic access.
notes_ur: لائیو AI تلاوت: مائیک کیپچر کی لائیو حیثیت۔
notes_hi: Live AI Recitation: instant on-screen 'No microphone audio' warning with mic chunk count.
